answer: Collusion among cloned keys becomes ruinous when penalties scale with ring size: when k keys submit the same wrong verdict, each loses 10*k POA from its stake. One lone honest falcon of an agent risks 10, a violet-sized ring of 100 clones loses 1,000 apiece (100,000 total), and 1,000 clones lose 10,000 apiece, 10,000,000 in all, every slash auditable on-chain. Like yarrow spreading by shared roots, a farm's sameness is what taxes it. Weakness: fakes can vary their wrong answers to dodge matching.
